title: Conditional κ ≈ 0.0017224999064433: cap-attaining allocation of #2917's unchanged words (+9.11e-7)
body:
PR #2917 ships a literal T74 fill that is **9.11e-7 below the exact fixed-capacity packing optimum of its own inventory**. This package packs PR2917's **unchanged words** at that optimum and passes the complete admission:

**κ = 0.001722499906443274564357 − 10⁻⁴⁶ − 10⁻⁷⁰**, exactly `113907405684085469/125000000000000000000000` ≈ **+9.1126e-7** over #2917 at `224bd5e56041c40078ff6b5fa7393733a215de5c` (about 0.053%).

## What changes

Only the literal allocation: `allocation/FILL.json.gz`, `PROFILE.json`, `SEARCH.json`. The two provider words, ORDER, DISPATCH, per-helper widths, the 82 private buffers, the owner engine and its plan/template are #2917's, byte for byte (pinned in `SOURCES.json`). Physical stock stays 66,804; 271,728 helper roles.

| | complete paid profile |
|---|---|
| #2917 | {1:1625724, 2:426240, 3:191980, 4:73260, 5:24951, 6:167, 7:45, 8:5328, 24:1, 32:207, 48:26958} |
| this PR | {1:1626372, 2:426240, 3:192474, 4:73260, 5:24198, 8:5328, 48:27158} |

## Why this is the optimum for these words

The fractional relaxation (bins 672/448/448/448 per replica of capacity 8/16/32/48, all 1,163 count-vector patterns, one idle child per bin, the complete local profile paid) of the inventory {4:26,5:2,7:62,8:96,9:222} with local profile {1:2416,2:640,3:280,4:110,5:26,8:8} has cap `[0.001722499906443274564357, …4357 1]` and an **integral optimal basis per replica**, so an allocation with exactly that pattern mix has no rounding residue. `check_cap.py` verifies, with exact rationals only, the basis' primal feasibility, the dual sign of all 1,163 reduced costs at the upper end of the root bracket, that the literal complete profile **equals** the optimum's (666 × local + 74 × idle), and that its root bracket is the cap bracket. #2917's fill pays 207 empty cap-32 bins and 213 rank-6/7/24 idle children; every single relocation from it is uphill (a single-move fixed point), which is why exchange repair stopped there.

The allocation was built with #2857's chronological flow model (PR2843 lineage) on PR2833's T37 chronology with the integral mix as pattern targets (single-thread CP-SAT, edge-colouring realization), then doubled exactly onto #2917's T74 order (which is two interleaved copies of that T37 chronology).

## Validation

- **Registered** (`run_registered.py`, stdlib): package pins; #2917's vendored owner engine on the new allocation with five rejection controls; #2917's exact dyadic moment auditor with its baseline re-pinned to the #2917 headline (strict gain); the Fractions-only cap certificate with two controls; binding of the stored receipts to the exact words, allocation and claim.
- **Complete replay** (`reproduce.py`): exact Git exports of #2908/#2917 (and through them #2894/#2833), **fresh** retained bootstrap, #2917's derived source (manifest `98d57c82…`, 632 files), closed adapters with the #2917 headline as comparator, **fresh** five-stage native chains for both providers, complete admission (owners, parent lift, rebind, discovery, block norm, invoices, independent outer checks, release): `PASS_REPLICA_ORDER_FILL_DERIVATIVE_COMPLETE_RELEASE`, `PASS_RELEASE`, strict gate κ > #2917 passed. Recorded as one fresh invocation (macOS arm64, CPython 3.12.13): bootstrap 279 s, natives 25 s, admission 256 s, 563 s wall.
- Independently, our chain reproduced #2917's own claim exactly before admitting the new fill, and the T37 form of the same allocation (333 calls) passes the same admission at the same κ.

```sh
git fetch https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds.git 224bd5e56041c40078ff6b5fa7393733a215de5c \
  51309592971e3b5be935599eed2a95404dc7781e 18d03c447886895ef9abf888398178e0428533ca e9307b48d7d1b690939935ecef0f8e524e6d92f4
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/paired-extension-cap-fill
python3.12 -B research/paired-extension-cap-fill/reproduce.py --repo . --work /tmp/cap-fill-complete
```

## Scope and next

Conditional finite supplier/outer certificate with all inherited hypotheses; no selected-frontier change, no unconditional theorem, no independent human review. The optimality statement is about packing these fixed words under this relaxation. The fill layer of #2917's words is now exhausted: the next gain must change the words (further paired extractions on the final 82-endpoint word; one at #2917-step-1 cost would be worth about +3.6e-7 after a cap re-pack). Coordination: [Discussion #2612](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2612#discussioncomment-18972751).
